Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

GoldenWindow’s folder comparator excludes .lock and .lock.owner from equality because they are volatile store artifacts. That test exclusion does not prevent ProjectSession.share or FileProjectStore from placing the lock artifact in an exported snapshot. The ticket requires exporter behavior, not a comparison filter. Exclude lock files at snapshot enumeration/write time and add an assertion over the actual exported bundle contents.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/journey/GoldenWindow.scala:129
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/platform/FileProjectStore.scala:74

Remaining / next action: Filter store locks from export construction and test the produced snapshot archive directly.

Disposition: Keep open.
